hero.title: Put the Veranda platform in your hands.
hero.body: The Evaluation Kit is a miniature version of our delivery box, with access to the Veranda mobile app and every feature of the platform. Set it up at your desk, test it with your team, and decide with real experience instead of a slide deck.

image.alt: The Veranda Evaluation Kit, a miniature version of the Dream Box delivery box

phone.alt: The Veranda Dashboard app on a phone

kit.title: The whole system, in a box you can hold
kit.body: Everything that makes a Veranda delivery box work is in the kit, shrunk down to a size that fits on a desk and works the same way.

items.title: A miniature delivery box
items.body: A working, scaled-down version of our Dream Box delivery box, with the Veranda smart lock built in. Open it, lock it, and see how a real handoff feels.

items.title: Access to the mobile app
items.body: The Veranda Dashboard app on your phone, paired with your kit. Unlock the box, share access with a colleague, and check its status from anywhere.

items.title: Every platform feature
items.body: Nothing is held back or demo-only. Access control, scheduling, monitoring, alerts, and the activity log all work in the kit just as they do in the field.

kit.featuresLabel: Features you can try on day one

features.title: Hands-free access
features.body: Walk up with the app on your phone and the box opens.

features.title: Shared & partner access
features.body: Invite teammates and give a one-time visitor temporary access.

features.title: Scheduled access
features.body: Set windows for the box to unlock, stay open, or lock again.

features.title: Device & sensor monitoring
features.body: Follow lock state, battery, connectivity, and live readings.

features.title: Activity & events
features.body: Look back at every open, close, and change in condition.

features.title: Status updates & alerts
features.body: Get notified when a delivery arrives or something looks unusual.

process.title: Four steps from request to your desk.

steps.title: Tell us what you’re building
steps.body: Send a short request with your use case and what you want to learn.

steps.title: Meet the team
steps.body: We schedule a call to confirm fit and shape the evaluation around your goals.

steps.title: Receive your kit
steps.body: Your miniature box ships to you with access to the mobile app.

steps.title: Review and plan next steps
steps.body: We gather your feedback and, if it makes sense, plan a pilot together.

request.title: Get an Evaluation Kit
request.body: Tell us a little about your organization and what you’d like to evaluate. We’ll follow up to confirm details and arrange your kit.

form.note: No commitment. A member of our team will reach out to set up an intro call and confirm where to ship your kit.

talk.title: Let’s discuss
talk.body: Not ready for a kit, or have questions about a partnership? Book time with our team to walk through the platform and see what fits.
